sections.name: ViewsNav
sections.title: Navigation bar and industry dropdown
sections.what: Chooses the industry from context or the dropdown, lists industries that have projects, rewrites each link for that industry, and highlights the current page.
sections.why: Likely reason: one fixed list of views can serve any industry by rewriting its address.
sections.watch_out: With an industry context set, choosing a different industry in the dropdown changes nothing on the links.

summary: A strip of links to the nuclear industry pages, with a dropdown to point those links at another industry.
purpose: Lets the owner move between the summary, dataset, map, forecast and other views of an industry from inside a tool.
why: The header describes these as cross-app views for the live nuclear workspace, shown inside tool headers. Reason for the copy-and-replace approach not stated in the code.
how: 1. Reads the current page address and the industry context. 2. Chooses the industry slug from the context, or from the dropdown when there is no context. 3. Lists industries that have projects. 4. Builds each link by replacing the nuclear part of the address with the chosen slug. 5. Marks the link matching the current page as active.
inputs: The current address, the industry context, the industry availability data, and the fixed list of views.
outputs: A navigation bar with a dropdown and nine links.
risks: If the address does not contain the nuclear segment, the replacement does nothing and links stay on nuclear. The dropdown has no effect when an industry context is already set.
debug: If links point to the wrong industry, check the industry context and the dropdown selection. If the dropdown has only nuclear, check the availability data.
